approval.add_face_id_first: Add Face ID or a fingerprint in Settings first: this {device} approves with one.
approval.adding_face_fingerprint_later_e: Adding a face or fingerprint later ends this device's approval key, so you approve this device again then.
approval.approving_asks_none_set_up: Approving asks for {either}, and none is set up on this {device} yet. Set it up in {kind}, then come back.
approval.approving_needs_none_set_up: Approving needs {either}, and none is set up. Set it up in {kind}.
approval.approving_needs_passcode_set_pa: Approving needs a passcode and {either}. Set a passcode in {kind}, then add {either_2}.
approval.can_not_used_right_try: {either} can't be used right now. Try again in a moment.
approval.cancelled_nothing_approved_requ: Cancelled, so nothing was approved. The request is kept: approve again when you're ready.
approval.cant_approve.none_enrolled: Approving needs a fingerprint on this phone.
approval.cant_approve.temporarily_unavai: The fingerprint sensor can't be used just now. Try again in a moment.
approval.cant_approve.unsupported: This phone can't approve. Approve from another supported device.
approval.check_timed_out: The fingerprint check timed out. Try again.
approval.device_can_not_approve_approve: This device can't approve. Approve on another device signed in to your account.
approval.did_not_recognise_you_nothing: {either} didn't recognise you, so nothing was approved. The request is kept: approve again when you're ready.
approval.first_taf: Setting up a taf needs approvals: Coach asks you to approve its tools and the taf's Card.
approval.has_no_face_id_touch: This {device} has no Face ID or Touch ID, so it can't approve. Approve on another iPhone, iPad or Android phone signed in to your account.
approval.has_no_passcode_needs_one: This {device} has no passcode, and {either} needs one. Set a passcode in {kind}, then add {either_2}, then come back.
approval.key_gone_approve_again: Your fingerprints changed, or none was recognized, so this phone can't approve until you approve it again in your browser.
approval.key_gone_biometry: Your {biometry} changed or wasn't recognized, so this device can't approve until you approve it again in your browser.
approval.key_gone_sign_in: Your fingerprints changed, or none was recognized, so this phone can't approve until you sign in again.
approval.key_lost: Sign in with KIFF again to approve from this phone.
approval.key_not_accepted: KIFF didn't accept this device's approval key. Try again.
approval.key_not_accepted_support: Still not working? Write to support@kiff.dev.
approval.locked_after_too_many_tries: {either} is locked after too many tries. Lock this {device}, unlock it with its passcode, then check again.
approval.locked_unlock_device: {either} is locked after too many tries. Unlock this device with its passcode, then try again.
approval.new_fingerprint: If you add another fingerprint later, approving on this phone stops until you approve it again.
approval.no_fingerprint: Add a fingerprint to this phone to approve from it. Refusing still works.
approval.not_recognized: Try again, or sign in again if your fingerprints changed.
approval.not_recognized_biometry: Try again, or sign in again if your {biometry} changed.
approval.nothing_approved_request_kept_a: Nothing was approved. The request is kept: approve again when you're ready.
approval.ready_approve: This {device} is ready to approve with {either}.
approval.set_a_screen_lock: Set a screen lock on this phone to approve
approval.settings_face_id_passcode_touch: Settings → Face ID & Passcode (Touch ID & Passcode on a device with Touch ID)
approval.state.none_enrolled: No fingerprint is set up on this phone. Add one in its settings, then come back.
approval.state.ready: Approvals are set up on this phone.
approval.state.temporarily_unavailable: The fingerprint sensor can't be used just now. Wait a moment, or unlock the phone once, then check again.
approval.state.unsupported: This phone has no fingerprint sensor tafs can use for approvals. Approve from another phone or a supported device.
approval.taf_asks_before_does_anything: A taf asks before it does anything outside its Card, and Coach asks before it connects an app or issues a Card. You approve on this device, and that needs Face ID or Touch ID.
approval.title: Set up approvals on this device
approval.turned_off_tafs_open_settings: {either} is turned off for tafs. Open Settings and turn on {either_2} for tafs.
approval.turned_off_tafs_turn_tafs: {either} is turned off for tafs. Turn it on in tafs' settings to approve.
approval.why: Every approval you give in tafs, a Card, a connection or a payment over a limit, is signed on this phone with a key only your fingerprint unlocks. Your PIN or pattern can't approve.
approval.without_allows: Without approvals you can still sign in, review, refuse and halt.
